title: Multi-currency support in payment validation
description: Modify payment validation logic to support multi-currency transactions and introduce validation for unsupported currencies. The validator must read the merchant supported currency list from the Currency Service, reject unsupported currency codes with UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY before funds are reserved, and store both the original and the converted settlement amount on the transaction record.
change_metadata: {"scenario": "SCENARIO_1", "expected_profile": "High impact - payments, currency, order and refund", "pull_request": "PR-4821"}

title: Update button text on the user profile page
description: Modify the label of the save button on the user profile page from 'Submit' to 'Save changes' and adjust the confirmation toast wording. No API contract, no persistence and no validation logic changes.

title: Transaction record schema change for settlement currency
description: Modify the database schema for transaction records: add settlement_currency and settlement_amount columns, backfill historical rows and add a composite index on (settled_at, currency). The ledger, reporting and refund read paths must be migrated in step with the schema.

title: Introduce step-up authentication validation for high value payments
description: Introduce a new authentication validation step: payments above the configured high-value threshold must present a fresh multi-factor authentication assertion. The auth service issues a step-up token and the payment service validates the assertion before authorisation.

title: Update notification email template
description: Update the order confirmation email template with the new brand header and footer. Template variables are unchanged; no service code is modified.

title: Refund API v2 with partial amount contract
description: Introduce version 2 of the refund API accepting an explicit partial amount and an idempotency key. The refund service must lock the refund aggregate to prevent concurrent over-refunding and continue to reuse the shared payment validator.

title: Cache FX rates in Redis to cut currency service load
description: Introduce a Redis cache in front of the FX rate feed, with a 15 minute TTL and rate-age propagation. Infrastructure change plus a small currency service change; conversion arithmetic is untouched.

title: Fix tax rounding in order total calculation
description: Correct the order total calculation so tax is rounded per currency minor unit after discounts rather than before, keeping the authorised amount equal to the displayed order total.

title: Integrate third-party fraud scoring vendor
description: Replace the in-house fraud rules with a third-party scoring vendor behind an anti-corruption layer. Screening stays synchronous in the checkout path but must fail open with a configurable timeout.

title: Optimise reconciliation reporting query
description: Add a covering index and rewrite the daily reconciliation query so refund reversals are not double counted and the job completes inside its window. Configuration and query change only.

title: Raise the departure test brake pipe pressure threshold TBC246
description: Change the brake pipe pressure precondition for the departure test: raise TBC246 from 80 psi to 85 psi and re-evaluate the feed valve setting validity window. The on-board segment must continue to display the 'Brake pipe pressure must be at least TBC246 PSI to begin departure test' prompt with a Cancel key when the precondition is not met.

title: Depart Test key availability in additional onboard states
description: Modify the Depart Test key availability logic so the key is offered in the CUT OUT state in addition to ACTIVE and DISENGAGED, keeping the parking function, penalty brake cut out switch and air brake cut-in preconditions unchanged.

title: Reorder Menu 1 soft keys on the crew display
description: Update the Menu 1 soft key order on the crew display so the Depart Test key appears in position two. Presentation change only; key preconditions are unchanged.

title: Reserve stock at add-to-cart instead of at payment
description: Move stock reservation in the Inventory Service from payment authorisation to add-to-cart, with a 15 minute reservation expiry. The Order Service must release the reservation when the cart expires or checkout fails, so flash sales cannot oversell.

title: Add express delivery with a second carrier
description: Extend the Shipping Service carrier adapter to support a second carrier for express delivery. Carrier selection is driven by the delivery option chosen at checkout; label format and tracking events stay the same.

title: Show real-time stock availability on product pages
description: Replace the cached availability flag in the Product Catalog Service with a live read from the Inventory Service and show 'Only 3 left' on product pages in the Frontend Portal. Availability must not be older than 60 seconds.

title: Stackable coupons with a per-order limit
description: Allow customers to combine up to two coupons in the Promotion Engine, enforce the per-order promotion limit and keep coupon redemption idempotent when checkout is retried in the Order Service.

title: Double loyalty points campaign for premium members
description: Configure a time-boxed campaign in the Loyalty Service that awards double points to premium members. Configuration change only; accrual rules for cancelled orders are unchanged.

title: Smart retry schedule for failed subscription renewals
description: Change the Subscription Billing Service to retry failed renewals on day 1, 3 and 7 using the plan currency, calling the Payment Service for each attempt, and suspend the subscription after the last failure.

title: Wallet top-up with saved cards
description: Introduce wallet top-ups with saved cards in the Digital Wallet Service. The top-up is a card payment through the Payment Service and the API Gateway; the wallet balance is credited only after capture and posted to the Ledger Service.

title: Automated chargeback evidence submission
description: Let the Chargeback Service assemble order, delivery and payment evidence automatically and submit it to the card scheme before the deadline. Webhook retries from the scheme must not post outcomes twice to the ledger.

title: Daily payouts for high-volume merchants
description: Move high-volume merchants from weekly to daily payouts in the Merchant Payout Service. Payouts must read settled balances from the Ledger Service and a live KYC status from the KYC Verification Service.

title: Tax engine upgrade for EU VAT rules
description: Upgrade the Tax Calculation Service rules for the new EU VAT one-stop-shop thresholds and round VAT per invoice in the Invoice Service instead of per line.

title: Annual KYC re-verification for merchants
description: Add a yearly re-verification job to the KYC Verification Service that asks merchants for fresh identity documents, rejects expired documents and pauses payouts until verification passes.

title: Per-channel marketing consent
description: Split marketing consent in the Consent Management Service into email, SMS and push, and make the Notification Service check consent at send time instead of from a nightly snapshot.

title: Record admin actions in the audit trail
description: Publish admin role changes and support impersonation sessions to the Audit Trail Service with actor, time and outcome. The event schema change is additive.

title: Typo tolerant product search
description: Enable one-letter typo tolerance in the Search Service and rank exact title matches first. Index and ranking configuration only; disabled categories stay excluded.

title: Biometric sign-in for the mobile app
description: Add Face ID and fingerprint sign-in to the Mobile App Backend. The Auth Service issues a device-bound token after biometric verification; sessions must still be revoked within 60 seconds of a password change.

title: Move payment events to a new Kafka cluster
description: Migrate payment event topics to a new Event Broker cluster with more partitions. The Payment Service publisher keys events by transaction id so ledger consumers keep transaction order.

title: Partial refunds from the support portal
description: Let agents raise partial refunds from the Customer Support Portal. The portal must call the Refund Service and reuse its shared validation so a refund can never exceed the captured amount.

title: Add refund reason codes to the nightly finance extract
description: Add refund reason codes to the Finance Data Warehouse nightly extract. Extract query change only; refund reversals must still be counted once.

title: Pay for subscriptions with gift cards
description: Allow the Subscription Billing Service to take renewal payments from a gift card balance in the Gift Card Service before charging the saved card. Expired gift cards must be skipped.

title: Self-service return labels
description: Let customers create a return and download a return label themselves. The Returns Management Service authorises the return and the Shipping Service generates the label; the refund is triggered when the return is approved.

title: Shorten the overspeed warning time TBC008
description: Reduce TBC008 from 8 to 6 seconds in the Speed Enforcement Module so a penalty brake application starts sooner when the train stays above the authorised speed. The overspeed warning must still be displayed before enforcement.

title: Validate consist length and weight at initialisation
description: Make the Consist Data Manager reject consist data with a missing or zero train length or weight, and make the Braking Curve Calculator stop using default consist values once the crew has entered them.

title: Record crew acknowledgements in the event recorder
description: Extend the Event Recorder to store every crew acknowledgement with speed, position and time within TBC002 seconds. Additive logging change.

title: Timed temporary speed restrictions
description: Support temporary speed restrictions with a start and end time in the Speed Restriction Manager. Bulletins from the Back Office Interface gain two optional fields, and each restriction is enforced only on the named track.

title: New signal aspect codes for the western subdivision
description: Add four new aspect codes to the Signal Aspect Processor aspect table for the western subdivision. Unknown codes must still be treated as the most restrictive aspect.

title: Add a GPS antenna check to the power-on self-test
description: Extend the Onboard Health Monitor self-test with a live GPS antenna check instead of the cached result, and report a failure to the crew display before initialisation.

title: Reduce the radio link loss timeout TBC045
description: Reduce TBC045 from 45 to 30 seconds in the Radio Link Manager and stop keep-alive frames without payload from resetting the loss timer.

title: Crew login by badge scan
description: Allow crew login by badge scan in the Crew Login Module, validating the employee ID against the crew list from the back office. Blank employee IDs must still be rejected.

title: Braking curve update for heavy haul consists
description: Update the Braking Curve Calculator for heavy haul consists above 12,000 tons using the entered consist weight and length, keeping the overspeed warning timing of the Speed Enforcement Module unchanged.

title: Checksum validation for onboard configuration files
description: Make the Configuration Loader verify a checksum for every onboard configuration file at load and enter the FAILED state on a mismatch.

title: Port Build 7 ECR -1 to Build 8: Depart test not perfomed well
description:
When onboard is Displaying Begin Departure Test prompt, resulting by pressing Init key, and when 1010 is sent to go non-controlling, onboard is displaying Depart test as Failed

Scenario
-Make sure Depart test is passed
-Enable Depart flag (Toggle Brake interface from EBI)
-begin Initializing
-send 1010 "Command locomotive system state to Non-controlling" at Begin Depart Test prompt
-Press Depart test key at cutout and observe 2011 report
Observe Depart test shows depart test report as Failed even though no departure test is performed after prvious depart test is passed

title: Port Build 7 ECR -2 to Build 8: Flrt3: Horn state doesn't change on brake/horn interface screen
description:
When the Horn key is pressed on the "brake/horn interface" screen, Ob doesn't update the Horn state field to Active, and it continues to show Inactive on the screen.

This is working fine on "EBI Slot 6 - EBI Onboard Diagnostics" and "System Test - Brakes" Screen.

This issue is only observed for SR-FLRT3-DMU. For SR-KSS_EMU, Ob is working correctly.
steps_to_reproduce:
1. Set control type SR-FLRT3-DMU and bring OB to cutout
2. Open OB diagnostic screen
3. Go to the Brake/Horn interface row and press the show details key
4. Ensure OB displays the Brake/Horn interface screen
5. Press the Horn key
6. Observe OB keep showing Horn state as Inactive
observed_behavior: On pressing the Horn key, OB keeps showing the Horn state field status as Inactive
expected_behavior: OB should update the horn state field as Active
